sprite.name: OTACON — MGS4
sprite.game: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots — original PS3 release
sprite.incarnation: Original personalised Dité survival engineer costume for MGS4 Hal Emmerich: adult glasses, brown hairstyle/face and human proportions retained, naturally grown short survivor beard, repaired pale-grey long field/lab coat, dark navy work layers, mechanical repair tools and compact air supply on utility harness. No canonical released Survive incarnation claimed.

sources.scope: Source incarnation identity appearance only; this costume is an original design, not a released canonical costume.

limits: Original costume design has no attested released canonical appearance; absolute canonical 1:1 is not claimed.
Native imagegen output bytes are preserved unchanged. Read-only source geometry is not pixel editing.
All physical pose keys, original UID/actionMap/phaseMap remain inherited; this is not original-game animation extraction.
A manual review and actual Canvas readiness/routing check must finish before runtime registration.
Generated native pixels remain intact; source reviewed against identified canonical reference. This is a faithful 2.5D adaptation, not certified pixel-perfect 1:1 original game footage.
Sixteen actual authored physical keyposes per direction,32 per fighter; action groups explicitly share keyposes. No 72-frame or motion-capture claim.
Canonical identity/outfit/equipment/anatomical sides reviewed; gameplay mechanics, hitboxes and original moves remain authored game adaptations.
Canvas source rectangles and optional vector silhouette clipping isolate native poses without rewriting PNG pixels.
Released CGI outfit followed; back seams hidden from reference are restrained authored reconstruction, not extracted original polygon certification.
Unarmed support poses and recovery are authored gameplay adaptations; no canonical firearm is invented.
